name: Ossuarch (sword and shield)
about: The Ossuarch, from Derek's painting (ossuarch_009202c4_2): black plate, a tall pointed iron helm with a slit visor, a bone brow band and nine vertebrae up its spike, a pale green plume rising from the tip; a dark teal hood and mantle; nine charm bones on the chest and belt; a mail skirt between plate tassets; great layered pauldrons with bone rims cut with tally notches in nines; a long tattered teal cloak to the ground.
